title: Mack Superliner High Tensile Aluminium Road Train Bullbar #23
description: Mack Superliner FUPS Bullbar. 88mm dia pipe, 100mm dia available. Indicator and daytime running lights in channel. Custom driving light mounts to customer requirements. Extra pipe in front of grille for additional protection. The centre light bar will accommodate a LED Light Bar plus driving light mounts. Full length box uprights for maximum protection. Reversible Road Train & Long vehicle signs, cowcatcher and 4 small uprights. High tensile aluminium backing plate with 38mm tow pin. Chrome plate over tow hitch. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
